tests.boundary: Narrator entry proves semantic exposure, not exhaustive Narrator certification; no transcript or repeat journey is required.

tests.exactJourney: At increased text/display size in portrait: choose an area, open/close Alerts, start/cancel a report, rotate once.
tests.pass: Essential controls remain touchable, readable, scrollable, and unobstructed by browser chrome in both orientations.
tests.distinctPhysicalClaim: Touch geometry, platform font reflow, Chrome obstruction, and rotation repaint.

tests.exactJourney: With increased text: choose an area, open/close Settings, rotate once.
tests.pass: Fixed controls and sheet endpoints remain visible, readable, scrollable, and outside notch, home indicator, and Safari chrome.
tests.distinctPhysicalClaim: WebKit viewport, notch/safe-area, increased-text rendering, and rotation repaint.

tests.deviceBrowser: Same Android device / installed standalone PWA
tests.exactJourney: Install, cold-launch standalone, open/close Alerts, change My Area, background/foreground, and relaunch.
tests.pass: Standalone scope and controls work, shell is nonblank, and expected area state persists.
tests.distinctPhysicalClaim: Browser installability and OS-managed standalone/relaunch lifecycle.
